title: Rival Cheerleader Hypnotizes You
description:
You’re supposed to be out there cheering on your man, the quarterback in the big game. But you’re in the locker room doing what? Checking out the cheer captain for the rival team? You like cheerleaders? Or are you just jealous? Maybe you’re worried I’ll take your man. Maybe you should be.

But soon you won’t care. You won’t even want that idiot anymore. He’ll be free for me to use and toss aside, while you explore your naughtier side. I’m going to unlock that part of you. All you have to do is let my cheer, my uniform, and your latent bisexuality hypnotize you into letting go of all your inhibitions.

Art by Rielilu.
author: Mistress Calia
